newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer - Keane named in 20-man Ireland squad.
newsitem.headline: Soccer - Keane named in 20-man Ireland squad.

text.p: Manchester United midfielder Roy Keane was on Tuesday named in the 20-man Republic of Ireland squad for the World Cup qualifying match against Iceland at Lansdowne Road on November 10.
Keane, 25, has played only once for Ireland since Mick McCarthy succeeded Jack Charlton as Ireland manager in February.
Paul McGrath of Derby County and Gary Kelly of Leeds United, both of whom missed the 3-0 defeat of Macedonia earlier this month, were both excluded from the squad.
GOALKEEPERS - Alan Kelly (Sheffield United), Shay Givens (Blaackburn Rovers).

DEFENDERS - Denis Irwin (Manchester United), Phil Babb (Liverpool), Jeff Kenna (Blackburn Rovers), Curtis Fleming (Middlesbrough), Gary Breen (Birmingham City), Ian Harte (Leeds United), Kenny Cunningham (Wimbledon).
MIDFIELDERS - Steve Staunton (Aston Villa), Andy Townsend (Aston Villa), Roy Keane (Manchester United), Alan McLoughlin (Portsmouth), Jason McAteer (Liverpool), Liam O'Brien (Tranmere Rovers).
FORWARDS - Keith O'Neill (Norwich City), John Aldridge (Tranmere Rovers), Tony Cascarino (Olympique Marseilles), Alan Moore (Middlesbrough), David Kelly (Sunderland).
